title: Greengrocers stack oranges the provably best way
body: Kepler conjectured in 1611 that the familiar pyramid stack of spheres, face-centred cubic, is the densest possible packing at about 74 percent. Thomas Hales's 1998 proof ran to hundreds of pages plus code and took journal referees years to certify; a fully machine-checked version finished in 2014. Cannonballs, crystals and oranges share one optimum.
